name: Why is my new bathroom faucet dripping after installation?

mainEntity.name: Why is my new bathroom faucet dripping after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new bathroom faucet dripping after installation can indicate several issues. It might be due to improper seating of internal components, an overtightened or undertightened connection, a faulty O-ring or washer, or even debris in the water line preventing a full seal. If you experience this, it's best to contact Alpha-Plumbing Services to inspect and resolve the problem promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A dripping new faucet can be caused by improper installation, faulty components, or debris; professional inspection is recommended.
